name: Smart Home
description: Netflix-style rows on the Jellyfin home screen.
overview: Netflix-style home rows (because you watched, top picks, new arrivals) plus auto-updating smart collections for movies and TV, with posters. Requires File Transformation.

versions.changelog: Smart Shelves built in: movie and TV collections with posters, kept up to date automatically. Top rated and recent hits per genre. TV in the home rows.
